svg.title: NetScope architecture
svg.desc: Data flow: scanners, importers and agents deliver observations to the core (inventory, history, time series, vault, SQLite). Processors such as diff, CVE, health and topology evaluate the changes and raise events. The rule engine bundles, throttles and escalates them and delivers through Telegram, ntfy, e-mail, webhook and n8n. Everything runs in one Go binary with an embedded web UI and API.
